admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
A little note about your weekly digest

We think the people on your supporter account would love to see how your week went, and sharing can be a lovely way to feel supported. Right now, though, your digest stays with you: nothing is sent to them unless you switch Sharing on in Settings.

If you do, they will see your practice minutes and how many check-ins you completed - never anything you write in your journal. You are free to switch Sharing on or off whenever you like, and either change applies from your next digest.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Sharing summary - weekly digest

- Recipient: the supporter account linked to this profile.
- Current status: not shared. The digest is sent only after the member switches Sharing on.
- Contents when shared: practice minutes and the number of completed check-ins. Journal text is never included.
- Control: the member may switch Sharing on or off at any time in Settings. A change applies from the next digest.
